common_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished wide 16:9 HEXBLADE motion-graphics CONCEPT BOARD, not a real gameplay screenshot or final UI asset. Input image 1 is the adopted Chroma combat UI visual style and world reference; input image 2 is the approved lobby graphic language. Match dark aubergine/navy hard paper panels, warm ivory cut edges, condensed bold italic typography, lime halftone corners, mint functional accents, orange resources, coral danger. Mechanically clipped 12-degree slashes, crisp screen-print shapes, controlled asymmetry, genuinely polished action game art direction. No human figures, new mascots, new character portraits, neon holograms or gold sparkles. Reuse only the small olive mech/red sword and three-eye cyan drone implied by image1. Keep text short and spelled exactly; English master headings with a tiny Korean subline where requested. Central gameplay should remain open unless explicitly a result screen.
Board layout: ONE large beautiful 16:9 gameplay composition fills upper 76% of board, using the purple industrial combat world of image1; a narrow separated dark design strip across bottom24% shows THREE small sequential motion keyframes labelled IN / HIT / OUT, plus minimal crisp time captions. Never duplicate the entire HUD in this bottom strip. This is a readable design presentation showing screen placement and snappy kinetic typography. Show motion through short offset graphic echoes, clipping boundaries and directional wedges; avoid excessive blur over readable text. Main state is tack sharp, subordinate accents 20-50ms behind, elastic squash and single short overshoot, rapid directional exit. Existing corner HUD remains subordinate. Do not depict a constant full-screen obstruction, do not add invented currency or random cooldowns. No watermarks.
